turns.text: Good afternoon. This is Meera, a consultant with Divyaashree Developers. I'm calling about Whispers of the Wind, near Nundhee Hills. Do you have a couple of minutes to speak?
Go on. I was looking at villa plots, but I assumed something closer in — Whitefield or Sarjapur.
Understood. This one sits in Nundhee Valley, on the Nundhee Hills, Devanahalli corridor, not in Whitefield. Were you looking at a home for yourselves, or more as an investment?
For us. We want to move out of an apartment over the next few years. Budget is not the issue — we can do up to two crore.

Perfect, that band fits. Plots here begin at ninety-two point four lakh and go to about two point four six crore, taxes included. The open question is geography. Nundhee is a highland weekend and second-home landscape, not a city neighbourhood. How do you feel about that corridor?
Honestly, too far. I still come into the city four days a week. I don't want a two-hour mistake.

That is a fair read, and I will not talk you past it. This valley is meant for people who want the hills, the seventy-four percent open space, and a slower weekend — not a weekday commute. If the location still feels off, I will not push.
I appreciate that. If you had something inside the outer ring I would listen. This one is not for me.
Understood. I will not set a visit. Thank you for being direct — it saves both of us a drive. I hope you find a plot that sits closer to the life you already have. I'll let you go.
